purpose: Map every action-specific non-BLIND runtime session to its exact historical candidate invocation without selecting a repeat or dropping a failed/search attempt.

mapping_rules.direct_h_m_f: exact source result basename within the same circuit and mode; same-stage match is preferred, otherwise exactly one cross-stage manifest match is required for shared full-prefix evidence
mapping_rules.f_search_probe: exact circuit, stage, scheme, h_patterns and m_patterns parsed from the F run_id
mapping_rules.shared_h_prefix: charge the same observed H attempt to every historical HMF invocation that names it; reuse is not free
mapping_rules.retry_sessions: retain every remediated session and its known retry order
